speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what is the number of citizens and Permanent Residents who could not pay for their MediShield Life premiums since its implementation; (b) what are the main reasons; and (c) what is the total amount of premiums owed.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This includes Singaporeans living overseas and those who cannot be contacted.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We are reaching out to remind Singaporeans and help them with their MediShield Life premiums.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: Just a quick question: can the Ministry share whether the trend of non-payment of MediShield Life premiums is actually going up or down?

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: As Mr Png is aware, MediShield Life started in November last year.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: So, this is the first year that we are administering MediShield Life.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: In this way, we have a good universal medical insurance scheme that is for all and for life.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
